### Release Notes

<details>
<summary>dawidd6/action-send-mail (dawidd6/action-send-mail)</summary>

### [`v20`](https://redirect.github.com/dawidd6/action-send-mail/releases/tag/v20)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/dawidd6/action-send-mail/compare/v19...v20)

#### BREAKING CHANGE

`HTTP_PROXY` is no longer respected, use `SMTP_PROXY` environment variable.

#### What's Changed

- build(deps): bump nodemailer from 9.1.1 to 10.0.0 by [@​dependabot](https://redirect.github.com/dependabot)\[bot] in [#​315](https://redirect.github.com/dawidd6/action-send-mail/pull/315)
- Take the proxy from `smtp_proxy` instead of `HTTP_PROXY` by [@​silverwind](https://redirect.github.com/silverwind) in [#​316](https://redirect.github.com/dawidd6/action-send-mail/pull/316)

#### New Contributors

- [@​silverwind](https://redirect.github.com/silverwind) made their first contribution in [#​316](https://redirect.github.com/dawidd6/action-send-mail/pull/316)

**Full Changelog**: <https://github.com/dawidd6/action-send-mail/compare/v19...v20>

</details>
